twoFactorSetup.title: Turn on two-factor authentication
twoFactorSetup.description: Besides your password, you'll need a 6-digit code from an app on your phone to sign in.

step1.title: 1. Link your authenticator app
step1.qrAlt: QR code to set up two-factor authentication
step1.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
step1.manual: Setting up from this same phone? Copy the key and enter it manually in the app:

help.install: Install an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy.
help.add: In the app, tap "Add account" and scan the QR code (or enter the key manually).
help.code: The app will show a 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds. Type it below.
help.lost: Save the key above in your password manager: if you lose or change your phone, you can link the app again with it.

errors.invalidCode: That code isn't right. Use the one your app shows right now (it changes every 30 seconds).
errors.generic: We couldn't verify the code. Please try again.

enabled.title: 2FA turned on
enabled.description: From now on you'll need a code from your app to sign in.
